 (1,\"file-b8be78cf-3b86-4da7-8b10-75a56d8073f3\"),

rows=[]
for ep, fid in FILES:
    out=subprocess.run([\"./nipa\",\"call\",\"danmaku.tracks\",json.dumps({\"entityId\":fid})],capture_output=True,text=True)
    d=json.loads(out.stdout)[\"result\"]
    tr=d[\"tracks\"]
    rows.append({\"ep\":ep,\"tracks\":len(tr),\"tracks\":tr})
    for t in tr:
        print(\"ep%02d origin=%s count=%s loaded=%s enabled=%s platform=%s vid=%s\" % (
            ep, t.get(\"origin\"), t.get(\"count\"), t.get(\"loaded\"), t.get(\"enabled\"),
            (t.get(\"provenance\") or {}).get(\"platform\"), (t.get(\"provenance\") or {}).get(\"platformVideoId\")))
json.dump(rows, open(\"work/verify_tracks.json\",\"w\"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python3 work/verify.py' 2>&1"
